comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Google Translate says:

"Increased bombardment damage and reduced damage in battle with phantom beasts."

Incidentally, JP wiki says this is a passive skill. It can be obtained by using the following materials:

Steel x50 + Munitions Chambers + Monster Battle Room

See the third ingredient's page for further details.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: You need x3 OSPs to add this skill, not x1.
